Package io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.importer

Class ImportData

java.lang.Object
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.importer.ImportData
public class ImportData extends Object
DTO for the data source backing an import or an import task, as returned by GET /rest/imports/{id}/data and GET /rest/imports/{id}/tasks/{taskId}/data.

type is "file" or "directory" — the /data/files sub-resource (see ImporterManager.listImportDataFiles(long)) only returns results when type is "directory"; GeoServer returns 400 ("Data is not a directory") otherwise. Verified against GeoServer 2.28.2.
